messages:
maria: Heads-up — deploybot blocked the v0.12.3 image publish to eu-west-1. It pushed to us-east, but mirror failed on metadata validation.
akash: error logs?
maria: deploybot message: `PUBLISH_REJECTED: invalid registry annotation 'region.timezone'` when replicating manifestlist -> eu-west-1. Full line: `replicate: annotate_check failed: timezone format invalid`
deploybot: [bot] publish failed for `redwood/runner:v0.12.3` -> eu-west-1 (code=PUBLISH_REJECTED)
sasha: that's odd — we didn't inject timezone anywhere in the build pipeline. Which step adds annotations?
maria: the new image-annotator step (rollout last week) adds `region.timezone` for runtime metrics. Looks like GCR/EU mirror enforces regex stricter than staging.
liam: can we strip that annotation on mirror? quick fix: remove annotate step for mirrors, or change value to `UTC` canonical format.
akash: quick check — the original manifest on us-east has `region.timezone: UTC+0`. eu-west validator expects `UTC` or `UTC±HH:MM`. so `UTC+0` fails.
ops-bot: rollback window in effect until 22:00 UTC. Any production rollbacks need +1 approver.
maria: proposal: pin the canary to previous digest for the change window and patch the annotator to emit `UTC` exact. Steps: 1) pin traffic for canary 2) revert annotator config 3) republish corrected image and promote.
akash: +1 for pin. I'll run the pin and open a rollback PR for release notes.
sasha: also add an integration test to the annotator that validates annotation regex against mirrors (eu/gcr). We missed that.
liam: command to pin: `deploybot promote --image redwood/runner@sha256:7a8b9c... --target canary --note "pin: tz-annotation-fix"`
maria: akash can you run that and confirm status?
akash: running now...
deploybot: [bot] promoted redwood/runner@sha256:7a8b9c... to canary (by akash) — traffic pinned.
nina: I'll draft the release note blurb: "v0.12.3: temporary pin due to registry annotation validation; fix incoming for timezone annotation format." anyone object?
sasha: fine. Also schedule the republish for the 01:00 UTC change window to avoid user impact.
maria: agree. akash, after annotator fix, please publish to staging and paste the `sha256` here before canary -> prod. ops-bot, note manual promotion after QA.
ops-bot: noted. Change window scheduled: 2026-04-02T01:00:00Z. Approvals required: sla-owner + eng-release.
akash: will follow up with CI logs.
maria: thanks. Major takeaway: add mirror validation to annotator CI and canonicalize timezone output. :white_check_mark:
